# ChatTranslator

**Category:** Misc  
**Aliases:** ChatTranslator

## What it does

Translates incoming/outgoing chat messages.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/Pan4ur/ThunderHack-Recode/blob/49c76bcc5a5e4fbd12b06305c09f0c8fb76c510b/src/main/resources/assets/thunderhack/lang/en_us.json).
